versos.hebraico: וּמִן־הַתְּכֵ֤לֶת וְהָֽאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת הַשָּׁנִ֔י עָשׂ֥וּ בִגְדֵי־שְׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֞וּ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

controles.web: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments, for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E do material azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, fizeram as vestimentas do ministério para ministrar no santuário, e também fizeram as vestiduras sagradas para Arão; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־הָאֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃

controles.web: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
controles.kjv: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
controles.livre: Fez também o éfode de ouro, de azul e púrpura e carmesim, e linho torcido.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְרַקְּע֞וּ אֶת־פַּחֵ֣י הַזָּהָב֮ וְקִצֵּ֣ץ פְּתִילִם֒ לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת בְּת֤וֹךְ הַתְּכֵ֨לֶת֙ וּבְת֣וֹךְ הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן וּבְת֛וֹךְ תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וּבְת֣וֹךְ הַשֵּׁ֑שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה חֹשֵֽׁב׃

controles.web: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, in the purple, in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.
controles.kjv: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
controles.livre: E estenderam as placas de ouro, e cortaram cachos para tecê-los entre o azul, e entre a púrpura, e entre o carmesim, e entre o linho, com delicada obra.

versos.hebraico: כְּתֵפֹ֥ת עָֽשׂוּ־ל֖וֹ חֹבְרֹ֑ת עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י קצוותו חֻבָּֽר׃

controles.web: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. At the two ends it was joined together.
controles.kjv: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
controles.livre: Fizeram-lhe as ombreiras que se juntassem; e uniam-se em seus dois lados.

versos.hebraico: וְחֵ֨שֶׁב אֲפֻדָּת֜וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֗יו מִמֶּ֣נּוּ הוּא֮ כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ֒ זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work; of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E o cinto do éfode que estava sobre ele, era do mesmo, conforme sua obra; de ouro, material azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ אֶת־אַבְנֵ֣י הַשֹּׁ֔הַם מֻֽסַבֹּ֖ת מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב מְפֻתָּחֹת֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם עַל־שְׁמ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E lavraram as pedras de ônix cercadas de engastes de ouro, gravada de gravura de selo com os nomes dos filhos de Israel:

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣שֶׂם אֹתָ֗ם עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָאֵפֹ֔ד אַבְנֵ֥י זִכָּר֖וֹן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

controles.web: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E as pôs sobre as ombreiras do éfode, por pedras de memória aos filhos de Israel; como o SENHOR o havia a Moisés mandado.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת־הַחֹ֛שֶׁן מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃

controles.web: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod; of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
controles.kjv: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
controles.livre: Fez também o peitoral de primorosa obra, como a obra do éfode, de ouro, azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido.

versos.hebraico: רָב֧וּעַ הָיָ֛ה כָּפ֖וּל עָשׂ֣וּ אֶת־הַחֹ֑שֶׁן זֶ֧רֶת אָרְכּ֛וֹ וְזֶ֥רֶת רָחְבּ֖וֹ כָּפֽוּל׃

controles.web: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its breadth a span, being double.
controles.kjv: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
controles.livre: Era quadrado; dobrado fizeram o peitoral: sua comprimento era de um palmo, e de um palmo sua largura, dobrado.

versos.hebraico: וַיְמַלְאוּ־ב֔וֹ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה ט֣וּרֵי אָ֑בֶן ט֗וּר אֹ֤דֶם פִּטְדָה֙ וּבָרֶ֔קֶת הַטּ֖וּר הָאֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;
controles.kjv: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
controles.livre: E engastaram nele quatro ordens de pedras. A primeira ordem era um sárdio, um topázio, e um carbúnculo: este a primeira ordem.

versos.hebraico: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י נֹ֥פֶךְ סַפִּ֖יר וְיָהֲלֹֽם׃

controles.web: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;
controles.kjv: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
controles.livre: A segunda ordem, uma esmeralda, uma safira, e um diamante.

versos.hebraico: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לֶ֥שֶׁם שְׁב֖וֹ וְאַחְלָֽמָה׃

controles.web: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
controles.kjv: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
controles.livre: A terceira ordem, um jacinto, uma ágata, e uma ametista.

versos.hebraico: וְהַטּוּר֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔י תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֖הַם וְיָשְׁפֵ֑ה מֽוּסַבֹּ֛ת מִשְׁבְּצ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב בְּמִלֻּאֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.
controles.kjv: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
controles.livre: E a quarta ordem, um berilo, um ônix, e um jaspe: cercadas e encaixadas em seus engastes de ouro.

versos.hebraico: וְ֠הָאֲבָנִים עַל־שְׁמֹ֨ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל הֵ֛נָּה שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל־שְׁמֹתָ֑ם פִּתּוּחֵ֤י חֹתָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־שְׁמ֔וֹ לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שָֽׁבֶט׃

controles.web: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
controles.kjv: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
controles.livre: As quais pedras eram conforme os nomes dos filhos de Israel, doze segundo os nomes deles; como gravuras de selo, cada uma com seu nome segundo as doze tribos.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲשׂ֧וּ עַל־הַחֹ֛שֶׁן שַׁרְשְׁרֹ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר׃

controles.web: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
controles.kjv: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
controles.livre: Fizeram também sobre o peitoral as correntes pequenas de feitura de trança, de ouro puro.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וּשְׁתֵּ֖י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ אֶת־שְׁתֵּי֙ הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃

controles.web: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
controles.kjv: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
controles.livre: Fizeram também os dois engastes e os dois anéis, de ouro; os quais dois anéis de ouro puseram nas duas extremidades do peitoral.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ הָעֲבֹתֹ֣ת הַזָּהָ֔ב עַל־שְׁתֵּ֖י הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת עַל־קְצ֖וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃

controles.web: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
controles.kjv: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
controles.livre: E puseram as duas tranças de ouro naqueles dois anéis aos extremos do peitoral.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨ת שְׁתֵּ֤י קְצוֹת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָֽעֲבֹתֹ֔ת נָתְנ֖וּ עַל־שְׁתֵּ֣י הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצֹ֑ת וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֛ם עַל־כִּתְפֹ֥ת הָאֵפֹ֖ד אֶל־מ֥וּל פָּנָֽיו׃

controles.web: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.
controles.kjv: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
controles.livre: E fixaram as duas extremidades das duas tranças nos dois engastes, que puseram sobre as ombreiras do éfode, na parte dianteira dele.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וַיָּשִׂ֕ימוּ עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֣וֹת הַחֹ֑שֶׁן עַל־שְׂפָת֕וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֶל־עֵ֥בֶר הָאֵפֹ֖ד בָּֽיְתָה׃

controles.web: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.
controles.kjv: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.
controles.livre: E fizeram dois anéis de ouro, que puseram nas duas extremidades do peitoral, em sua orla, à parte baixa do éfode.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֮ שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָב֒ וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֡ם עַל־שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֤ד מִלְמַ֨טָּה֙ מִמּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔יו לְעֻמַּ֖ת מֶחְבַּרְתּ֑וֹ מִמַּ֕עַל לְחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד׃

controles.web: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
controles.kjv: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
controles.livre: Fizeram também dois anéis de ouro, os quais puseram nas duas ombreiras do éfode, abaixo na parte dianteira, diante de sua juntura, sobre o cinto do éfode.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת־הַחֹ֡שֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתָיו֩ אֶל־טַבְּעֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֜ד בִּפְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֗לֶת לִֽהְיֹת֙ עַל־חֵ֣שֶׁב הָאֵפֹ֔ד וְלֹֽא־יִזַּ֣ח הַחֹ֔שֶׁן מֵעַ֖ל הָאֵפֹ֑ד כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E ataram o peitoral de seus anéis aos anéis do éfode com um cordão de material azul, para que estivesse sobre o cinto do mesmo éfode, e não se separasse o peitoral do éfode; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת־מְעִ֥יל הָאֵפֹ֖ד מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג כְּלִ֖יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃

controles.web: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
controles.kjv: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
controles.livre: Fez também o manto do éfode de obra de tecelão, todo de azul.

versos.hebraico: וּפִֽי־הַמְּעִ֥יל בְּתוֹכ֖וֹ כְּפִ֣י תַחְרָ֑א שָׂפָ֥ה לְפִ֛יו סָבִ֖יב לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ׃

controles.web: The opening of the robe in its midst was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.
controles.kjv: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
controles.livre: Com sua abertura em meio dele, como a abertura de um colarinho, com uma borda em derredor da abertura, para que não se rompesse.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ עַל־שׁוּלֵ֣י הַמְּעִ֔יל רִמּוֹנֵ֕י תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֑י מָשְׁזָֽר׃

controles.web: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.
controles.kjv: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
controles.livre: E fizeram nas orlas do manto as romãs de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ פַעֲמֹנֵ֖י זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֶת־הַפַּֽעֲמֹנִ֜ים בְּת֣וֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִ֗ים עַל־שׁוּלֵ֤י הַמְּעִיל֙ סָבִ֔יב בְּת֖וֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִֽים׃

controles.web: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;
controles.kjv: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
controles.livre: Fizeram também os sinos de ouro puro, os quais sinos puseram entre as romãs pelas orlas do manto ao redor entre as romãs:

versos.hebraico: פַּעֲמֹ֤ן וְרִמֹּן֙ פַּעֲמֹ֣ן וְרִמֹּ֔ן עַל־שׁוּלֵ֥י הַמְּעִ֖יל סָבִ֑יב לְשָׁרֵ֕ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: Um sino e uma romã, um sino e uma romã ao redor, nas orlas do manto, para ministrar; como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־הַכָּתְנֹ֥ת שֵׁ֖שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָֽיו׃

controles.web: They made the coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
controles.kjv: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
controles.livre: Igualmente fizeram as túnicas de linho fino de obra de tecelão, para Arão e para seus filhos;

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ הַמִּצְנֶ֣פֶת שֵׁ֔שׁ וְאֶת־פַּאֲרֵ֥י הַמִּגְבָּעֹ֖ת שֵׁ֑שׁ וְאֶת־מִכְנְסֵ֥י הַבָּ֖ד שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃

controles.web: and the turban of fine linen, and the linen headbands of fine linen, and the linen breeches of fine twined linen,
controles.kjv: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
controles.livre: Também a mitra de linho fino, e os adornos das tiaras de linho fino, e os calções de linho, de linho torcido;

versos.hebraico: וְֽאֶת־הָאַבְנֵ֞ט שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: and the sash of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: Também o cinto de linho torcido, e de material azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, de obra de bordador; como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־צִ֥יץ נֵֽזֶר־הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיִּכְתְּב֣וּ עָלָ֗יו מִכְתַּב֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it a writing, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO YAHWEH”.
controles.kjv: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
controles.livre: Fizeram também a prancha da coroa santa de ouro puro, e escreveram nela de gravura de selo, o rótulo, SANTIDADE AO SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ עָלָיו֙ פְּתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת לָתֵ֥ת עַל־הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E puseram nela um cordão de azul, para colocá-la em alto sobre a mitra; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֕כֶל כָּל־עֲבֹדַ֕ת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃פ

controles.web: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses; so they did.
controles.kjv: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.
controles.livre: E foi acabada toda a obra do tabernáculo, do tabernáculo do testemunho: e fizeram os filhos de Israel como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés: assim o fizeram.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבִ֤יאוּ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־הָאֹ֖הֶל וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו קְרָסָ֣יו קְרָשָׁ֔יו בריחו וְעַמֻּדָ֥יו וַאֲדָנָֽיו׃

controles.web: They brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
controles.kjv: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
controles.livre: E trouxeram o tabernáculo a Moisés, o tabernáculo e todos os seus utensílios; seus colchetes, suas tábuas, suas barras, e suas colunas, e suas bases;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־מִכְסֵ֞ה עוֹרֹ֤ת הָֽאֵילִם֙ הַמְאָדָּמִ֔ים וְאֶת־מִכְסֵ֖ה עֹרֹ֣ת הַתְּחָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַמָּסָֽךְ׃

controles.web: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,
controles.kjv: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,
controles.livre: E a coberta de peles vermelhas de carneiros, e a coberta de peles finas, e o véu da cortina;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־אֲרֹ֥ן הָעֵדֻ֖ת וְאֶת־בַּדָּ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃

controles.web: the ark of the testimony with its poles, the mercy seat,
controles.kjv: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
controles.livre: A arca do testemunho, e suas varas, e o propiciatório;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ אֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃

controles.web: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,
controles.kjv: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
controles.livre: A mesa, todos os seus utensílios, e o pão da proposição;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֨ה הַטְּהֹרָ֜ה אֶת־נֵרֹתֶ֗יהָ נֵרֹ֛ת הַמַּֽעֲרָכָ֖ה וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַמָּאֽוֹר׃

controles.web: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,
controles.kjv: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
controles.livre: O candelabro limpo, suas lâmpadas, as lâmpadas que deviam manter-se em ordem, e todos os seus utensílios, e o azeite para a luminária;

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֑ים וְאֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹֽהֶל׃

controles.web: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,
controles.kjv: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
controles.livre: E o altar de ouro, e o azeite da unção, e o incenso aromático, e a cortina para a porta do tabernáculo;

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣ת׀ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת וְאֶת־מִכְבַּ֤ר הַנְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ אֶת־בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־כַּנּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: the bronze altar, its grating of brass, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,
controles.kjv: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
controles.livre: O altar de bronze, com sua grelha de bronze, suas varas, e todos os seus utensílios; e a pia, e sua base;

versos.hebraico: אֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶחָצֵ֜ר אֶת־עַמֻּדֶ֣יהָ וְאֶת־אֲדָנֶ֗יהָ וְאֶת־הַמָּסָךְ֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֶת־מֵיתָרָ֖יו וִיתֵדֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֗ת כָּל־כְּלֵ֛י עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן לְאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,
controles.kjv: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
controles.livre: As cortinas do átrio, e suas colunas, e suas bases, e a cortina para a porta do átrio, e suas cordas, e suas estacas, e todos os vasos do serviço do tabernáculo, do tabernáculo do testemunho;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י הַשְּׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן׃

controles.web: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
controles.kjv: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.
controles.livre: As vestimentas do serviço para ministrar no santuário, as sagradas vestiduras para Arão o sacerdote, e as vestiduras de seus filhos, para ministrar no sacerdócio.

versos.hebraico: כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֑ה כֵּ֤ן עָשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת כָּל־הָעֲבֹדָֽה׃

controles.web: According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
controles.kjv: According to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
controles.livre: Em conformidade a todas as coisas que o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés, assim fizeram os filhos de Israel toda a obra.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨רְא מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־כָּל־הַמְּלָאכָ֗ה וְהִנֵּה֙ עָשׂ֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה כֵּ֣ן עָשׂ֑וּ וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֹתָ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

controles.web: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
controles.kjv: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the Lord had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
controles.livre: E viu Moisés toda a obra, e eis que a fizeram como o SENHOR havia mandado; e abençoou-os.
